title: Canonical denominator-product injection and its cokernel support bounds
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], $F$ a coherent module [pqf-def-coherent] with nonzero stalk at every point [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Suppose that on every affine open $U$, every associated prime of $\Gamma(U,F)$ is minimal among its associated primes (associated primes are prime annihilators of nonzero elements). Let $L$ be invertible [def-sc-invertible-module] and $s:\mathcal O_X\to K_X(L)$ a regular meromorphic section: its canonical extension $K_X\to K_X(L)$ is monomorphic [def-sc-meromorphic-module]. Put $I=\mathcal O_X\times_{K_X(L)}L$, with projections $i:I\to\mathcal O_X$ and $j:I\to L$. Using the tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], write $f=(i\otimes F);\lambda_F:I\otimes F\to F$ and $g=(j\otimes F);\beta_{L,F}:I\otimes F\to F\otimes L$. Put $A=\operatorname{im}(f)=IF$ with its image factor $q:I\otimes F\to A$ and inclusion $a:A\to F$ [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk]. There exists a monomorphism $j_F:A\to F\otimes L$ with $qj_F=g$. At every point $x$, vanishing of $(\operatorname{coker}i)_x$ implies vanishing of $(\operatorname{coker}a)_x$, and vanishing of $(\operatorname{coker}j)_x$ implies vanishing of $(\operatorname{coker}j_F)_x$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-hilbert-denominator-kernel-comparison]. In the abelian category of module sheaves, g descends through coimage(f), which is canonically image(f). Reverse the roles of f and g to produce maps image(f) to image(g) and back. Precompose their composites with the epimorphic image factors to see that both composites are identities. The desired jF is this isomorphism image(f) to image(g), followed by the monomorphic inclusion image(g) to F tensor L. This also proves the factorization and monomorphism.

Tensoring on the left by F is left adjoint to internal Hom, so it preserves cokernels; symmetry transfers this to tensorRight F. Thus coker(i tensor F) is (coker i) tensor F, and likewise for j. Composing with an isomorphism does not change a cokernel, and replacing a map by its image inclusion does not change its cokernel. These universal properties identify coker(product inclusion) with (coker i) tensor F and coker(jF) with (coker j) tensor F.

The stalk tensor comparison [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-tensor] identifies a tensor-product stalk with the tensor of its stalks. If the first stalk is zero, this tensor is zero. Transport this vanishing along the cokernel isomorphisms of the preceding step to get the two pointwise support implications.

theorem hilbert_denominator_maps {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (F : X.Modules)
    (hFcoh : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F)
    (hFsupport : ∀ x : X, ¬ Subsingleton ((presheaf F).stalk x))
    (hFnoEmbedded : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (_ : IsAffineOpen U)
      (p : Ideal (Γ(X, U))),
      p ∈ associatedPrimes (Γ(X, U)) (Γ(F, U)) →
        Minimal (fun q : Ideal (Γ(X, U)) =>
          q ∈ associatedPrimes (Γ(X, U)) (Γ(F, U))) p)
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (s : unit X ⟶ meromorphicModule X L)
    (hs : Mono (meromorphicSectionMap X L s)) :
    ∃ jF : idealModuleProduct (pullback.fst s (toMeromorphicModule X L)) F ⟶ tensorObj F L,
      factorThruImage ((pullback.fst s (toMeromorphicModule X L)) ▷ F ≫ (λ_ F).hom) ≫ jF =
        (pullback.snd s (toMeromorphicModule X L)) ▷ F ≫ (β_ L F).hom ∧
      Mono jF ∧
      (∀ x : X,
        Subsingleton ((presheaf (cokernel (pullback.fst s (toMeromorphicModule X L)) :
          X.Modules)).stalk x) →
        Subsingleton ((presheaf (cokernel (idealModuleProductι
          (pullback.fst s (toMeromorphicModule X L)) F) : X.Modules)).stalk x)) ∧
      (∀ x : X,
        Subsingleton ((presheaf (cokernel (pullback.snd s (toMeromorphicModule X L)) :
          X.Modules)).stalk x) →
        Subsingleton ((presheaf (cokernel jF : X.Modules)).stalk x))
